script: The coldest known natural place in the universe is the Boomerang Nebula. It is about minus 272 degrees Celsius, just one degree above absolute zero. That is colder than the faint glow left over from the Big Bang. It is cold because gas is rushing away from a dying star and cooling as it expands. It lies about 5,000 light-years from Earth.
